reasons: Nearest weekly expiry 09 Nov (3.0 days to go).
Delta 0.52: the option moves about 0.52 points for every index point in your favour (target band 0.50 to 0.70, late in the day or short-dated, so we pay for delta rather than theta)
Gamma 0.0011: delta rises about 0.05 after a 50-point move your way, so winners accelerate and losers hurt less.
Theta -26.6 per day (about -4.3 per trading hour, 2.7% of the premium): time is the cost of waiting, so exit if the move stalls.
Vega 9.0 per volatility point: a 1-point fall in India VIX costs about 9.0 per unit, so avoid buying right before events that crush volatility.
The index must move about 307 points your way just to recover the premium (premium divided by delta).
Volatility input: implied from the live 25050 CE at 146.30 (16.7%), held constant. The premium at your stop and targets is a model estimate around it.

logic.title: 15m bias
logic.text: On the 15m, the latest structure break is up: price closed above 24,702.6 on 2026-11-06 13:00 (BOS), so the 15m has turned up and is still up. That is the only 15m requirement here. It stays valid while price does not trade below 24,570.8.

logic.title: 5m structure
logic.text: On the 5m, price broke above the lower high at 24,576.1 on 2026-11-06 09:45 (CHoCH), then pushed through 24,901.7 on 2026-11-06 15:05 with a strong displacement candle (BOS number 3: the trend broke structure again after a pullback, so this is a continuation zone). Two steps in a row mean the 5m trend has really changed from down to up, not just bounced.

logic.title: Entry zone
logic.text: The order block 24,872.3 to 24,885.8 (the last down candle before the displacement) and the fair value gap 24,901.7 to 24,923.0 (the gap the move left behind) form the entry zone 24,872.3 to 24,923.0. Only one of the two is present, so the zone is a notch weaker. Unfilled orders usually wait in a demand zone, which is why price tends to react there.

logic.title: Pullback
logic.text: Price has come back to 25,030.3, inside or just above the zone, and the pullback low so far is 24,780.3. Buying a pullback instead of the breakout gives a close stop and a better reward-to-risk.

logic.title: Confirmation
logic.text: Confirmed: a 5m rejection candle in the zone (long wick, close back above the middle). Still missing: a 5m close back above the 9 EMA. Do not enter until every item is in: waiting costs a little price and saves a lot of bad trades.

logic.title: Confluences
logic.text: Key level: A round number, previous-day high/low or the broken structure level sits inside the zone, so more orders cluster there. MTF EMA: Price is on the trend side of the 9 EMA on the trigger timeframe and the one above it, so the timeframes agree.

logic.title: Stop-loss
logic.text: SL 24,761.0 sits below the order block and the pullback extreme with a 0.25 ATR buffer. If price trades through it, the 5m structure is broken and the idea is wrong, so you leave with a small, planned loss. Risk to the stop is 0.6% of price

logic.title: Targets
logic.text: T1 25,352.0 is the previous swing high where resting orders sit (3.0R). T2 25,208.8 is 2R and T3 25,358.0 is 3R. Take part profit at T1 and let the rest run with a trailing stop.

logic.title: Cautions
logic.text: Convert the index stop to premium (points x delta) and size to your fixed risk; Stop after two losses in a day.

execution: Strike: buy NIFTY 24900 CE (expiry 2026-11-09). Model premium 160.4; check the live price and skip or size down if it is more than 15% above the model (volatility spiked).
Size: lots = risk in rupees divided by (premium risk per unit x lot size 65). Premium risk per unit is about 68.4 at the stop.
Order: limit at or near the ask when the 5m trigger candle closes. Market orders on options can fill far from the quote.
Stop: exit if a 5m candle closes below the index level 24,761.0. Set a TradingView alert on the index; the option stop is about 92.1.
Exit plan: half at index T1 25,352.0 (about 480.0), a quarter at T2 25,208.8, trail the rest on the 5m 9 EMA.

trail.action: Index stop 24,761.0 (premium about 92.1). Never average down.
Sell half. Move the stop to your cost price.
Sell a quarter. Move the stop to the T1 level 25,352.0 on the index.
Trail under each new 5m higher low or exit on a 5m close below the 9 EMA.

trail.when: No progress in 6 to 8 candles (30 to 40 minutes)
trail.action: Exit. Theta is working against you every minute you wait.
Exit everything. Do not carry weekly options overnight.

rules: Never widen the stop and never average down an option.
Expiry day: no new buys after lunch, or size down hard.
Stop for the day after two losses.
